New subsidiary plans to focus on small and mid-sized U.S. AI data centers, using modular construction and multiple power sources


NEW YORK, NY, Nov. 19, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Chaince Digital Holdings Inc. (Nasdaq: CD) (“Chaince Digital” or the “Company”), a digital finance and technology company focused on tokenization, on-chain innovation, and regulated brokerage services, today announced the formation of Chaince Compute Inc. (“Chaince Compute”), a wholly-owned subsidiary incorporated in Delaware on November 2, 2026. Chaince Compute intends to pursue the development of artificial intelligence (“AI”) data center projects in the United States.


As demand for AI computing grows, sites with available power capacity have become a key constraint on new data center development. Chaince Compute’s planned approach has three elements:


- **Small and mid-sized U.S. projects** – a focus on developing AI data center projects in the United States with target power capacity of up to 100 megawatts (“MW”) each;
- **Integrated, modular construction** – an integrated, modular build model intended to shorten construction timelines, with a target construction period of under 12 months per project; and
- **Multiple power sources** – combining grid power with other power sources, such as solar and energy storage, with the aim of addressing limited grid capacity.


To source potential projects, Chaince Compute intends to identify sites with existing or obtainable power capacity, including grid-connected sites such as cryptocurrency mining facilities that could be converted into AI data centers. It intends to pursue development of such sites in collaboration with site owners and holders of power capacity, through joint ventures or other structures, and to lead negotiations with prospective tenants.


Chaince Digital previously operated a Filecoin distributed storage business in the United States from 2022 to 2026, with its servers hosted by a third-party data center service provider.


“We firmly believe in the build-out of AI infrastructure in the United States,” said Shi Qiu, Chief Executive Officer of Chaince Digital and Chaince Compute. “Long construction timelines and limited power are among the key bottlenecks facing the industry today. We intend to adopt a more efficient, modular approach to construction and to supplement conventional grid power with diversified power sources, with the aim of addressing both.”


**About Chaince Digital Holdings Inc.**


Chaince Digital Holdings Inc. (Nasdaq: CD) is a digital finance and technology company focused on tokenization, on-chain innovation, and regulated brokerage services. The Company aims to bridge traditional financial markets with the emerging digital-asset economy through compliant, scalable, and institutional-grade infrastructure. For more information, please visit[www.chaincedigital.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=bRs_DAXh6sw2Ms8ZobprKQCiCho_lFOyTbI7hlMTgNnpisfe0tLcnqHUxD8rmbq4_1QQ9QbdNIzCGZFkBzuFwIbwDeQtsWAyzdNqDqSXn04=) .
